# ibee_cdn_origin (Resource)

An HTTPS custom origin for IBEE CDN. Terraform manages origin configuration, not the remote origin server. Remove dependent distributions before deleting the origin.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_cdn_origin" "app" {
  name       = "app"
  origin_url = "https://origin.example.com"
}
```

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default_url` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `name` | `string` | Required |  |
| `origin_url` | `string` | Required |  |
